tools.name: speechcraft_status
tools.description: Get SpeechCraft acoustic studio status, active wake word, sensitivity, and registered control port 14132

tools.name: speechcraft_list_audio_devices
tools.description: List all host physical audio input devices (microphones, webcams, audio interfaces)

tools.name: speechcraft_configure_wake
tools.description: Configure wake word keyword (wakeywakey, hey_jarvis, alexa, hey_mycroft), sensitivity (0.0..1.0), and spoken greeting

tools.name: speechcraft_route_intent
tools.description: Route natural voice command to fleet agent command bus (fritz, codercraft, robotcraft, calibre, plexy)

tools.name: speechcraft_synthesize
tools.description: Synthesize vocal speech from text with prosody shaping and optional audio output playback

tools.name: speechcraft_export_wav
tools.description: Generate broadcast-mastered EBU R128 (-16.0 LUFS) WAV byte buffer metrics

tools.name: speechcraft_verify_voiceprint
tools.description: Biometrically authenticate acoustic samples against enrolled local voiceprint profiles

tools.name: speechcraft_list_voiceprints
tools.description: List enrolled biometric voiceprint profiles and 32-dim embedding telemetry

tools.name: speechcraft_timeline_manage
tools.description: Manage spoken literature audiobook timeline paragraphs (list or append)

tools.name: speechcraft_list_output_devices
tools.description: List host speaker / audio output devices (CPAL). Empty means no OS output visible.

tools.name: speechcraft_get_settings
tools.description: Get persisted studio settings (audio, wake, bus router, STT/TTS providers, locale, theme) plus honesty notes about live vs simulated paths.

tools.name: speechcraft_probe_router
tools.description: TCP-probe the fleet voice-bus router (default 127.0.0.1:10996). Returns live-router vs local-fallback-simulated mode.
